programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess meets Sandra Kinsela at the cattle sale yards and likes her instantly, only to discover Claire dislikes her intensely. Their childhood dispute is renewed when a herd of calves is stolen from Drovers Run and Claire is convinced that Sandra is responsible.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost of Things to Come

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.
programme.sub-title: The Things We Do For Love

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: Incredible African Wildlife
programme.desc: It's Christmas time, and the savannah is filled with animals including frogs, wild dogs and hyenas.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Covering over seventy per cent of the globe, oceans are the planet's defining environment. Yet, this underwater world remains one of mystery as they are deep, varied, and diverse habitats.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Wetlands are among the most productive and biologically diverse ecosystems on the planet. These aquatic landscapes can be found around the world and include swamps, marshes, bogs, and the animals they attract.

programme.title: World of the Wild

programme.title: Everything I Never Expected
programme.desc: Opposites attract when a spoiled bachelor and a broke college grad accidentally become roommates. Forced to cohabitate in a less-than-ideal apartment, they clash, prank, and eventually fall for each other. Life challenges and misunderstandings complicate their budding romance, but true love prevails.

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash." Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: Letters from the Bottle
programme.desc: An accomplished writer finds his way back to his work after experiencing a tragedy.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House 2: Taking the Throne
programme.desc: Kionna has taken full control of her dead boyfriend's drug empire. She has taken the throne to become the official Queen of the Trap House. However, a new man steps into her life causing her to shift focus away from the criminal enterprise. Kionna also begins dealing with new enemies from rival drug gangs to law enforcement. Kionna will now need to show everyone what a true Queen does to maintain power.

programme.title: The House Sitter
programme.desc: A young college student takes a job as a house sitter and ends up in a deadly game of hide and seek.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: In the wake of a tragic emotional event, Angie Dobson is lead to do the unthinkable. She suffers from a history of sexual abuse. Instead of suppressing her feelings, she over indulges to satisfy her appetite for an unhealthy infatuation for her brother. These family secrets have been swept under the rug for years. Will this family be able to bounce back? Or will this family be torn apart from the acts of this Taboo.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city's most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka "Bunny & Clive". When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: Enter the Dominion
programme.desc: Media giant Jonathan Zander is known for his take no prisoners business attitude. Under suspicion, Zander must find a new, trustworthy person for his organization. When he meets the talented, yet socially challenged, Sheldon Marcus, he finds the perfect tool to funnel his next business deal through. The affects of this deal could cause damage, but He will stop at nothing to increase his profits.

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: Snow Black
programme.desc: Sarah Camden, a special operations soldier with PTSD, returns home to bury her mother. She realizes that she has to rid her hometown of gangs, drugs and crooked politicians. Sarah calls in her special ops buddies to clean up the town.

programme.title: Dawgs 4 Life
programme.desc: A story about four best friends who grew up on the south side of Chicago faced with poverty, drugs, jealousy, betrayal, and murder. They realize that all that they have is each other, when in reality, nothing is what it seems. Bound by a pact of loyalty, truth, and dedication to one another, it's money that causes they're alliance to break apart.

programme.title: The Queens Court
programme.desc: The Queens Court is an underground, all female organization that rules on all criminal activity in the city. Nothing is done without the queens courts verdict first, and those who fail to comply will be dealt with, by any means necessary.

programme.title: My Shattered Life
programme.desc: After a teenager resolves his own unfortunate circumstances, he's faced with another one that will not only affect him and others close to him, but the community.

programme.title: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: Jerry, a recently unemployed accountant, and his wife Stephanie face financial struggles after Jerry loses his job. They invite Jerry's best friend and mentor, Lionel, a music producer, to stay with them. Lionel turns out to be manipulative and begins a rivalry between Jerry and his friend Shawn. Lionel also tries to seduce Stephanie by exploiting her financial vulnerability. This betrayal leads to a chain of events that ends tragically, revealing a dark side of Jerry that he never knew existed.

programme.title: Don't Shoot
programme.desc: After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

programme.title: Single Saved and Searching
programme.desc: Leah puts all of her trust in God when it came to her relationships. For some reason her relationships still weren't working out. After a big breakup with a long time boyfriend Leah sends out a prayer that would turn into an unexpected journey. God gives Leah a gift that makes men appear at her will, but Leah still questions why God gave her this gift.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: Jacob and Mia Patterson have a seemingly perfect life. Good jobs, a healthy relationship, and financial freedom until one decision makes them question everything that's happened between them. With his job crumbling around him and his brothers questioning some of his financial moves, Jacob sets off on a dangerous path with a mysterious woman who is determined to plant herself directly in the middle of his life. The grass is not always greener in Paradise.

programme.title: Dangerous Affair
programme.desc: Erika and Ryan are a happily married couple living in a high rise Apartment in Atlanta, Ga. everything is going great until Erika meets a handsome, mysterious man in her building and they start having an affair. Once Ryan finds out about the affair Erika ends it. But the mystery man has other plans. Will the married couple survive the Dangerous Affair?

programme.title: When Girls Ride
programme.desc: When Samantha leaves the South to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close, and decide to start their own women's bike club. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a girl from their group to violence. The women respond accordingly in order to get justice for their friend.

programme.title: Poison Candy
programme.desc: Love scammer Candy, promises her crew one last con before swearing off the game, but what happens when the target turns out to be "the one".

programme.title: Black Girl Magic
programme.desc: Fall under the spell of these five hilariously talented black women from all walks of life, and all parts of the U.S., in this side splitting stand-up special. Starring NY's Brooklyn Jones, LA's Alycia Cooper, Chicago's Just Nesh, Milwaukee's Kelly Kellz and hosted by Atlanta's Ashima Franklin. Filmed on location live from Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

programme.title: The Kissing Bandit
programme.desc: After some bedroom issues, Dale Saunders, get kicked to the curb by his wife. One stormy night to his delight, a gorgeous redhead in distress shows up at his new pad and rekindles his lost lust. While she promises to fulfill his secret sexual fantasy, she prowls at night making the same promise to other men she seduces and rips-off with the help of an accomplice. When the media warns the public, Atlanta is swept with Kissing Bandit fever.

programme.title: No Love Lost
programme.desc: After finalizing their divorce Noah and Moriah find themselves going from lovers to roommates. Moriah has moved on already and began dating her co-worker Anthony, 6 months before the divorce was final. Noah is still in love with her but find himself falling for a waitress named Rochelle. Rochelle, with the help of his best friend Quincy, give Noah the motivation to stand up to Moriah in situations where he would be meek to say the least.

programme.title: Traces of Indignity
programme.desc: Dr. Augusta Weber has traveled the world over promoting her books, DVD's and selling out public speaking events. She is a retired College Professor who is greatly admired by all. Although Dr. Weber is an advocate for being straight-forward, open and honest, she is protecting a deep, dark secret that has plagued her for years. An aggressive journalist, Ruby, is determined to denounce Dr. Weber's character by uncovering the truth and scoring the next big story.

programme.title: An Earl E. Christmas
programme.desc: Earl falls into deep debt after making some bad bets. He decides to fake a terminal illness to get the debt collectors off his tail, only to have his entire family show up at his home for one last special Christmas. But dysfunction and old grudges start to bubble over, making for a chaotic holiday weekend.

programme.title: Festive Fling
programme.desc: After Shelly's painful divorce, she was left feeling like the black sheep of the family. Desperate to move on from the pain of her past, she invites her co-worker Greg to visit her family to pretend to be her boyfriend to deflect her family's unwanted comments. Little did she know, that her holiday fling, would become a holiday thing.

programme.title: Christmas Family Ties
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her mother, Amaya pleads to Santa to bring her family together for Christmas like they used to. Her father David, having fallen out with his siblings after his own mother's death, decides to bring her to their ancestral family home for the holiday. Will they survive the holiday with their own family dysfunction and financial ruin hanging over their heads?

programme.title: Hard Holiday
programme.desc: Thirty-year-old LaDonne, a hotel housekeeper and single mother of twins, fights to stay sober and stable. When job loss and family strain push her to a breaking point and arrest, rehab offers a chance at redemption. Guided by a counselor and a kind stranger, LaDonne begins to heal. Her brave performance at a Christmas event becomes a turning point, rebuilding dreams and finding hope.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.
programme.sub-title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.
programme.sub-title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young barman from The Maid in Splendour pub is found shot dead, Barnaby and Scott uncover a web of romantic intrigue involving several members of the bar staff.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The revival of a traditional festival at Midsomer Parva ends in tragedy when the curate, the Rev Alex Dakin, is burnt alive inside a straw effigy of a woman. Then his gay lover the priest, the Rev Jim Hale, dies too.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: It's Christmas and the troubled Villiers family get together nine years after the death of eldest son Ferdy, a magician. As Barnaby abandons his Christmas lunch with the in-laws to investigate, it seems as though ghosts from the past are haunting the household.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of `The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
